newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Indonesia Cilacap refinery due to restart Monday.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia Cilacap refinery due to restart Monday.

text.p: Indonesia's state oil company Pertamina said a 200,000-barrel-per-day (bpd) crude distillation unit (CDU) at its Cilacap refinery was due to restart on Monday after a maintenance shutdown which started on September 1.
"The refinery told me on Friday that the CDU is expected to resume operations in two days," a Pertamina spokesman said. "It should be back onstream later today."
The unit was originally scheduled to be down for 30 days.
Cilacap has two CDUs, with a smaller unit which has a 100,000-bpd capacity remaining operational. The smaller unit is scheduled to shut for maintenance in 1997.
The Cilacap refinery is located in Central Java.
